caveat: NVIDIA's throughput numbers are its own benchmark. The DDRop attack needs physical access to the server.

expert.text: By 2029 more than 75% of operations on untrusted infrastructure will be protected in use by confidential computing.

expert.by: IDC for the Confidential Computing Consortium
expert.text: Among 600+ IT leaders, 75% are adopting confidential computing and 18% run it in production; attestation validation is the top barrier at 84%.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Use confidential computing to unlock AI on sensitive data shared with partners.
lens.ciso: Demand verifiable attestation, and keep physical attacks in your hosting due diligence.
lens.cto: Pilot confidential GPUs for one regulated AI workload; the overhead is a few percent.
lens.eng: Try attestation tooling on one workload; a new IETF standard defines the evidence format.

line: Data stays encrypted even while it is processed, now also on AI chips.
scope: Protecting data while it is processed. Not where it is hosted.
